risks.description: Effects of climate change grow in frequency and intensity, disrupting company operations and local communities. Implications on global health and disease spread particularly important to health-focused organisations.
risks.mitigation: Committed to Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) to achieve absolute net zero for scope 1, 2 and 3 GHG emissions. Ambitious emissions reduction trajectory outperforms all IPCC scenarios limiting global warming to 1.5°C without offsetting. All sites required to develop roadmaps towards sustainable energy future. Assessing climate change-related risks with TCFD report update committed for 2024.

risks.description: Paris Agreement commitments driving countries and companies to reduce GHG emissions. European Green Deal and other factors driving stakeholder demand for emissions reduction results. Risk of not maintaining low GHG emissions levels as business grows.
risks.mitigation: Goal to eliminate all GHG emissions from operations and energy purchases by 2050. Action plans across sites to reduce emissions through innovative technologies and infrastructure upgrades. Energy-efficient equipment, evaluation of employee travel needs, GHG emissions-free vehicle fleet goal by 2030. Phasing out fossil fuel use and substituting with sustainable energy sources. Focus on real zero emissions without offsetting.

risks.description: Corrupt business behaviour (bribery, unfair advantages, theft, fraud, embezzlement, misuse of assets) persistent in interconnected competitive world. Exposure due to broad scope of worldwide operations and different stakeholder relationships.
risks.mitigation: Roche Group Code of Conduct outlines key integrity expectations. Behaviour in Business directive addresses anti-corruption and anti-bribery. Mandatory compliance e-learning for all employees and business-critical partners covering bribery, improper advantages, gifts/entertainment, conflict of interest, discrimination/harassment, responsible use of social media, business partners and supply chain. Training completed at joining and periodic refreshers. Reporting mechanism for potential violations with commitment to investigate and take corrective action.

risks.description: Global value chains spanning international borders create challenges ensuring workers' human rights. Risk of involvement with negative human rights impacts across 100,000+ employees and thousands of business partners. 2023 Group human rights risk assessment identified data privacy, access to healthcare, fair and safe work environment (own operations) and working conditions, fair treatment, non-discrimination, healthy work environment (supply chain) as focus areas.
risks.mitigation: Policies in place and risk management approach to mitigate and prevent human rights infringements and adverse impacts. Assessment includes reasonable grounds to suspect child labour. Upholding human rights principles across own operations and value chain.

risks.description: Inability to create inclusive work environment for people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and ideas risks not attracting and retaining talented people with needed innovation capabilities. Skills shortage and growing competition from existing and new players/geographies. Adapting to new agile and virtual ways of working requires iterative talent strategies, new skills, differentiated leadership and well-being focus.
risks.mitigation: Strategic workforce planning to identify future skills needs and prepare to attract and develop employees. Global Employee Opinion Survey (GEOS) every two years. Organisation-wide pay equity analysis every three years (2022 living-wage analysis to be repeated periodically). Information and programmes supporting physical and mental health and well-being. OneRoche Learning & Development Portfolio for all employees. Leadership Commitments setting clear expectations for people leaders with programmes (e.g., Symbiosis) to build leadership capability.

evidence: Genentech entered into strategic collaboration with Nvidia coupling Genentech's cutting-edge AI capabilities, extensive biological and molecular datasets, and research expertise with Nvidia's world-leading accelerated computing capabilities and AI to speed up drug discovery and development (2023)
Using AI at all stages of drug development process (digitalisation mentioned as key focus area by CEO)
AI opportunities to make work more efficient along entire value chain including testing and developing new methods in R&D
ai_positioning.summary_fr: Roche adopte une approche d'intégration de l'IA dans ses processus de découverte et développement de médicaments, notamment via un partenariat stratégique avec Nvidia en 2023. L'entreprise utilise l'IA à tous les stades du développement de médicaments pour améliorer l'efficacité et la rapidité, tout en s'appuyant sur ses propres capacités en IA et ses vastes bases de données biologiques et moléculaires.
